common.demo_banner: Demo environment - all names and figures are sample data
common.offline: You are offline. Some things may not work until your connection is back.
common.footer_owner: A Kasi Digital Hubs Initiative by :owner
kiosk.timeout_body: For your privacy you will be signed out in :seconds seconds.
error.403.title: You can't open this page
error.403.body: Your account doesn't have access to this page. If you think this is a mistake, ask your hub facilitator.
error.404.title: We can't find that page
error.404.body: The link may be old or typed wrongly. Go back to the home page and try again.
error.419.title: Your session expired
error.419.body: For your safety we closed the page after a while. Go back and try again.
error.429.title: Too many tries
error.429.body: Please wait a minute, then try again.
error.500.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.500.body: It's not your fault. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.503.title: We're doing maintenance
error.503.body: KasiHub will be back shortly. Thank you for your patience.
auth.phone.title: Sign in or create your free account
auth.phone.description: Use your cellphone number. No email or password needed.
auth.phone.label: Cellphone number
auth.phone.invalid: Enter a valid South African cellphone number, for example 072 123 4567.
auth.phone.bot_check_failed: We couldn't confirm you're a person. Please try again.
auth.phone.expired: You were signed out because you were inactive for a while. Please sign in again.
auth.phone.device_signed_out: This device was signed out from your account settings.
auth.phone.help: Need help? Visit your nearest Kasi Digital Hub.
auth.code.title: Enter the code we sent
auth.code.description: If :phone can be used, we've sent a 6-digit code to it. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.code.label: 6-digit code
auth.code.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the SMS or ask for a new code.
auth.code.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait :seconds seconds and try again.
auth.code.invalid_number: Enter a valid South African cellphone number.
auth.code.unavailable: We can't send codes right now. Please try again later or visit your hub.
auth.pin.title: Enter your PIN
auth.pin.label: 5-digit PIN
auth.pin.remember: This is my own phone - remember it for 30 days
auth.pin.remember_hint: Don't tick this on a shared or hub computer.
auth.pin.wrong: That PIN is wrong. You have :left more tries.
auth.pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Wait :minutes minutes or use 'I forgot my PIN'.
auth.pin.invalid_format: Your PIN must be exactly 5 numbers.
auth.pin.too_simple: That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated or sequential numbers like 11111 or 12345.
auth.pin.choose_hint: You'll use it to sign in. Don't use your birthday.
auth.new_pin.title: Choose a new PIN
auth.account.not_active: This account can't be used right now. Please contact your hub.
auth.signup.title: Create your free account
auth.signup.date_of_birth_hint: We use this to make sure our services are right for your age.
auth.signup.accept_terms: I have read and agree to the Terms of use and the Privacy notice.
auth.signup.optional_title: You choose what we do with your information
auth.signup.optional_hint: These are all optional. You can change them at any time in your account.
auth.declined.title: You need to be a bit older to sign up
auth.declined.body: KasiHub accounts are for people aged :age and older. Please visit your nearest Kasi Digital Hub with a parent or guardian to find out what we can help you with.
auth.guardian.title: We need a parent or guardian's OK
auth.guardian.description: Hi :name. Because you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree before you can use KasiLearn. We'll send them a code.
auth.guardian.name: Parent or guardian's full name
auth.guardian.code_description: We sent a code to :phone. Ask your parent or guardian to read it to you.
auth.guardian.invalid_phone: Enter your parent or guardian's own South African cellphone number.
auth.two_factor.setup_description: Staff accounts need a second step. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
auth.two_factor.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:
auth.two_factor.wrong: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
auth.two_factor.challenge_description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for KasiHub. Lost your phone? Use one of your backup codes.
auth.recovery.title: Save your backup codes
auth.recovery.description: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Write them down or print them and keep them somewhere safe. You won't see them again.
account.title: My account
account.email_hint: For receipts and certificates. We'll send a link to confirm it.
account.email_unverified: Not confirmed yet - check your inbox.
account.phone_code: Code sent to your new number
account.phone_unavailable: That number can't be used. Please use a different number or visit your hub.
account.devices_description: Devices where your account is signed in. Sign out any you don't recognise.
account.privacy_description: Choose what we may do with your information. Using KasiHub itself requires the Terms of use and Privacy notice.
account.purpose.platform_hint: Needed to have an account. To stop, delete your account.
account.purpose.job_matching_hint: Use my profile and CV to find jobs. Employers only see my details when I apply or agree.
account.purpose.learning_records_hint: Save my course progress and certificates, and share results with my course sponsor.
account.purpose.partner_sharing: Share with partners when I ask
account.purpose.partner_sharing_hint: Lets KasiStart send my details to a bank or insurer - only when I choose a specific offer.
account.purpose.whatsapp_updates_hint: Job matches, reminders and hub news on WhatsApp.
account.purpose.marketing_hint: Occasional news about programmes and events.
account.delete_description: We'll delete your account and personal information, except what the law requires us to keep. This can't be undone.
account.delete_confirm: I understand and want my account deleted.
account.deletion_requested: We've received your request. Your account will be deleted within 30 days.
account.deletion_pending: Deletion requested - your account will be deleted within 30 days.
consents.review.title: We've updated our terms
consents.review.description: Please read the changes and agree to continue using KasiHub.
hub.home.title: Welcome, :name
hub.home.coming: Your jobs, courses, business support and mentors will appear here as each service goes live.
profile.home_hub_hint: Your hub can help you in person - with your CV, courses and business registration.
profile.roles_hint: What you can do on KasiHub, and where.
profile.roles_none: You haven't started using any service yet.
notify.welcome.title: Welcome to KasiHub, :name
notify.welcome.body: Your account is ready. Find jobs, courses and business support - and visit your hub if you need help.
notify.document_verified.title: Your :document is verified
notify.document_verified.body: You won't need to upload it again - every KasiHub service can use it.
notify.document_verified.cause: A KasiHub reviewer checked your document
notify.document_rejected.title: We couldn't accept your :document
notify.document_rejected.body: Reason: :reason. Please upload a clear copy, or ask your hub facilitator for help.
notify.document_rejected.cause: A KasiHub reviewer checked your document
notify.document_expiring.title: Your :document expires soon
notify.document_expiring.body: It expires on :date. Upload a new one so your applications are not held up.
notify.document_expiring.cause: Your document has an expiry date
notify.role_assigned.title: You are now a :role
notify.role_assigned.body: You have the :role role at :where. Sign in to see your new tools.
notify.role_assigned.cause: An administrator gave you a new role
notify.security.new_device.title: New sign-in to your KasiHub account
notify.security.new_device.body: Someone signed in on :device. If this was not you, change your PIN now or visit your hub.
notify.security.pin_changed.title: Your KasiHub PIN was changed
notify.security.pin_changed.body: If this was not you, contact your hub immediately.
notify.security.phone_changed.title: Your KasiHub phone number was changed
notify.security.phone_changed.body: If this was not you, contact your hub immediately.
notify.security.cause: A security change on your account
documents.title: My documents
documents.description: Keep your documents safe in one place. Once a document is verified, every KasiHub service can use it - you upload it once.
documents.file_hint: PDF or a clear photo (JPG or PNG), up to 10 MB.
documents.none_hint: Add your ID, matric certificate or qualifications to apply faster.
documents.delete_confirm_body: The file is removed permanently. Services that used it will ask for it again.
documents.uploaded: Document uploaded. We're checking it for viruses - it will be ready in a moment.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how we contact you. Your updates page always shows everything. Security messages always come by SMS.
notifications.quiet_hours: We don't send WhatsApp or SMS messages between 20:00 and 07:00 - except security alerts.
notifications.whatsapp_consent: To get WhatsApp messages, switch on 'WhatsApp updates' under Privacy.
updates.title: Updates
updates.description: What changed and why - from every KasiHub service.
